text:
Alex (Sales): Hey finance team — quick approval ask. Pine Labs (SMB onboarding pilot) used trial capacity and ran ~$12,450 in overage last month. Sales proposes converting up to $10,000 of that into a 3-month committed credit applied across their next 3 invoices to smooth onboarding and keep them on Dedicated. cc @Mira @Sam

Mira (Finance): Can you paste the usage + cost breakdown and confirm whether they're willing to sign any commit/term for this conversion? we need ARR/MRR impact and revenue recognition note.

Alex (Sales): Breakdown below (rounded):
```
- Embeddings overage: $4,200
- Gen tokens overage: $6,150
- Support & infra overage: $2,100
- TOTAL: $12,450
Request: Convert $10,000 -> credit applied as $3,333 per invoice for next 3 invoices.
Sales note: Pine Labs is evaluating two vendors, will sign 6-month pilot if we offer this credit and commit to a 99ms median latency SLA on Dedicated.
```

Sam (RevOps): need to flag forecasting. If we do a $10k credit we write down revenue now or amortize? Also ask if credit is refundable or tied to a signed commit. Suggest conditional approval (signed 6mo commit).

Alex (Sales): Yep — they will sign a 6mo committed addendum (minimum $4k/mo) if we convert. Without credit they likely churn to competitor.

Jamie (Legal): I can draft a one-pager amendment. Terms we need: credit schedule, non-refundability clause (or refund trigger), explicit commit volume + overage rates post-credit, and termination clause. Route the signed doc to legal@redwood for countersign.

Mira (Finance): From finance POV: propose approving up to $8,500 conditional on: 1) signed 6-month commit addendum, 2) credit amortized over 3 invoices, 3) GL impact tracked under "promo_credits_q2" and forecast updated. If legal OKs T&Cs and RevOps sets renewal trigger, I can greenlight.

Sam (RevOps): Agree to conditional $8,500. We'll own the renewal trigger and add a note in the customer record to block automated churn workflows until the pilot end-date. :thumbsup:

Alex (Sales): Thanks — I'll push for signature today. If we get signed commit, please confirm pathway for billing to create the invoice adjustment.

Jamie (Legal): Drafting amendment now. Expect a PDF in ~2 business hours.

billing-bot: Invoice adjustment draft created: INV-2026-0043 (amount: $8,500 credit) — status: pending finance approval.
